assumptions: Valves of the same individual averaged in log10 space to give one observation per animal
RMA slope = sign(r)*sd(y)/sd(x); log10 of mm values
issues: 60 valve records belong to 49 individuals; 11 individuals have two valves (pseudoreplication).
summary: Joined catalogue to measurements, averaged log10 length/height across valves per individual, fitted RMA regression of log10 height on log10 length.
